products.identity: Mars Odyssey THEMIS-IR Day Global Mosaic 100m v12
products.coverage: Global: -90 to 90 degrees planetocentric latitude and 0 to 360 degrees east longitude
products.coordinate_system: Simple Cylindrical; planetocentric latitude; positive-east longitude; ellipsoid radii A=3,396,190 m and C=3,376,200 m
products.units: Qualitative, stretched/blended visual representation of daytime temperatures; not calibrated temperature units
limitations: A2 may use this only as a prototype visual raster. It cannot substantiate observed thermometry, thermal inertia, EVA constraints, or astronaut safety.

products.coverage: Jezero crater and Nili Planum regional map: 17.7 to 18.7 degrees N and 76.8 to 77.8 degrees E
products.coordinate_system: Archive-native CRS must be verified from included projection files after download; the A4 extractor requires a Mars-sphere Transverse Mercator CRS centered at 77.5 degrees E with metre axes.
products.resolution: Regional vector geologic map published at 1:75,000; not a terrain-resolution raster
products.units: Projected geometry axes in metres after CRS verification; unit labels are geologic map attributes, not terrain-risk scores
limitations: Regional geology provides science context only. It does not validate DEM/WMTS registration, rank targets, quantify terrain risk, or establish astronaut safety.
